Before you book with any website

Cheap-looking tickets online aren't always what they seem. A few quick checks can save you a lot of stress.

  • 🏢
    Check who you're payingLook for a real business name, an ABN and a local phone number you can actually call.
  • 💳
    Pay by card, not bank transferNever send money to a personal account. Paying by card lets you ask your bank for a chargeback if something goes wrong.
  • 🔍
    Read the fine print on cheap faresVery low prices can mean no checked bag, 20-hour layovers, separate tickets or no refunds.
  • ✈
    Confirm with the airlineOnce you've booked, check your booking reference on the airline's own website.
  • ⚠
    Be careful with social media sellersFacebook or WhatsApp "ticket agents" you can't verify are a common source of scams.
